note: Which manifest models ragdoll on death, as data. Each model names a rig family (bone map) and a body row; live=false keeps the baked death (no ragdoll is taken from the pool). A model with no row here (animals, drones, the hero) always takes the baked death. The simultaneous-ragdoll cap is data/physicsBudget.json; over it the death is baked too. Bodies are measured at the bind pose (package tools/glb-measure.mjs) with the manifest scale baked in.
